name: leg curl (on stability ball)
description: Lying on your back with heels on a ball, you curl it toward your hips. It works the hamstrings and core together.
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels on a stability ball and legs straight.
Press your hips up so your body forms a line.
Pull the ball toward your glutes by bending your knees.
Roll the ball back out slowly.
